segments.thag10.1:1.1: “Aṅgārino dāni dumā bhadante, phalesino chadanaṃ vippahāya;
segments.thag10.1:1.3: Te accimantova pabhāsayanti, samayo mahāvīra bhāgī rasānaṃ.
segments.thag10.1:2.3: Pattaṃ pahāya phalamāsasānā [phalamāsamāno (ka.)], kālo ito pakkamanāya vīra.
segments.thag10.1:3.1: “Nevātisītaṃ na panātiuṇhaṃ, sukhā utu addhaniyā bhadante;
segments.thag10.1:3.3: Passantu taṃ sākiyā koḷiyā ca, pacchāmukhaṃ rohiniyaṃ tarantaṃ.
segments.thag10.1:4.5: Yāya āsāya tiṭṭhāmi, sā me āsā samijjhatu.
segments.thag10.1:5.1: [saṃ. ni.1.198]“Punappunaṃ ceva vapanti bījaṃ, punappunaṃ vassati devarājā;
segments.thag10.1:5.3: Punappunaṃ khettaṃ kasanti kassakā, punappunaṃ dhaññamupeti raṭṭhaṃ.
segments.thag10.1:6.1: [saṃ. ni.1.198]“Punappunaṃ yācanakā caranti, punappunaṃ dānapatī dadanti;
segments.thag10.1:6.3: Punappunaṃ dānapatī daditvā, punappunaṃ saggamupenti ṭhānaṃ.
segments.thag10.1:7.1: “Vīro have sattayugaṃ puneti, yasmiṃ kule jāyati bhūripañño;
segments.thag10.1:7.3: Maññāmahaṃ sakkati devadevo, tayā hi jāto [tayābhijāto (sī.)] muni saccanāmo.
segments.thag10.1:8.1: “Suddhodano nāma pitā mahesino, buddhassa mātā pana māyanāmā;
segments.thag10.1:8.3: Yā bodhisattaṃ parihariya kucchinā, kāyassa bhedā tidivamhi modati.
segments.thag10.1:9.1: “Sā gotamī kālakatā ito cutā, dibbehi kāmehi samaṅgibhūtā;
segments.thag10.1:9.3: Sā modati kāmaguṇehi pañcahi, parivāritā devagaṇehi tehi.
segments.thag10.1:10.3: Pitupitā mayhaṃ tuvaṃsi sakka, dhammena me gotama ayyakosī”ti.
